description: eugr's (Eugene Rakhmatulin) spark-vllm-docker recipe for Intel's Qwen3.5-122B-A10B-int4-AutoRound (INT4, group size 128, AutoRound; Intel states to follow the licence of the original Qwen model, Apache-2.0; checkpoint revision 3045d02b, about 77 GB of weights) served by vLLM on a single Spark. Runs eugr's published vllm-node image (nightly-20260929, digest pinned; its build-metadata records spark-vllm-docker 42f62e34, vLLM 0.30.1rc1.dev336+gaf5b4857e and FlashInfer 4a638133) with upstream's launch: VLLM_MARLIN_USE_ATOMIC_ADD=1, InstantTensor loading, prefix caching, qwen3_xml tool parsing, qwen3 reasoning parsing, trusted remote code, eugr's fix-qwen3.5-chat-template mod (baked into the image at build time; the unsloth chat template it installs is selected with --chat-template), 262,144-token context, 8,192 batched tokens and memory utilisation 0.8 (upstream defaults); scheduler sequence capacity is left to vLLM as upstream does not set it. Upstream's recipe is written for two Sparks; eugr's --solo mode runs the same command at tensor parallel 1 (the only override), which is this single-Spark recipe; the weights fit one Spark. No upstream performance claims are recorded. Upstream repository MIT. Physical Spark acceptance is pending. GB10 memory correction: Per-node peak budgets utilization × 130,663,231,488-byte unified memory plus at least 8 GB for CUDA context/graphs, FlashInfer workspace, auxiliary heads and CPU/mmap buffers; 8 GB reserve, with a separate 6 GB OS floor. This is a conservative budget, not a measured footprint.
title: Qwen3.5 122B-A10B INT4 AutoRound vLLM single Spark (eugr)
